note: Towns drawn on the atlas that are NOT in the game yet. Coordinates are GTA world coords (like places.js). To make one real, move its roads into places.js ROAD_DEFS and its places into the matching module (shops.js, fuel.js, ...), then delete it from here. A town with "status": "real" is already in places.js: the atlas draws only its landmarks and buildings from here.

towns.about: Real since it moved into places.js: the district, its 7 roads, the diner and feed store (shops.js), the fuel stop (fuel.js) and the motel room (houses.js). The landmarks below have no game system yet, so they stay here and the atlas draws them.
